text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Pittsburgh Steelers for their home opener at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET, the team faces a significant challenge without wide receiver A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 and has been placed on injured reserve, sidelining him for at least four games—forcing the question of who will step up in his absence as Drake Maye and company look to bounce back. On the lighter side of things, Maye and his wife Ann Michael have been making headlines off the field for their generosity, surprising teachers at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence with a donation that covered the Amazon classroom wish lists of more than 50 educators, while the Kraft family and Patriots Foundation also donated $275,000 in the names of 2026 Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, with Susie Shaw of Carlisle receiving the $25,000 grand prize for William's Be Yourself Challenge. In roster moves, the Patriots re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad and released tight end Shane Zylstra from the practice squad, while owner Robert Kraft also made headlines by confirming he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due to what Kraft described as a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and
